# Hubert Zonyra

> Hubert Zonyra is a Frontend Engineer at Jampolls and a full-stack web developer based in Accra, Ghana. He studies Computer Science at the University of Ghana and is open to frontend, full-stack and freelance work.

## About
- Role: Frontend Engineer at Jampolls (February 2026 – present); previously Frontend Engineer Intern at Fihankra Comtech LLC.
- Location: Accra, Ghana (works remotely).
- Languages: English, Ewe.
- Contact: danielshubert9@gmail.com, or the contact form on the site.

## Skills
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, HTML, CSS.
- Backend: Node.js, Express, Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Prisma, MongoDB, Zod, REST APIs.
- Tools: Git, GitHub, Docker, Vercel, Railway, Linux, Jira, Linear, Plane, VS Code.

## Projects
- AgroMarket: full-stack marketplace connecting farmers, suppliers and buyers in Ghana (JWT auth, role-based access, Paystack, Cloudinary). https://agricultural-marketplace-nu.vercel.app/
- hubstore: e-commerce platform with Stripe checkout, Algolia search, NextAuth v5, Zustand and an admin dashboard.
- sakai watch: Telegram bot that monitors University of Ghana Sakai via GitHub Actions and sends alerts for announcements, assignments, grades, quizzes, files and deadlines.
- Sakai MCP server: TypeScript Model Context Protocol server that lets AI assistants read Sakai courses, assignments, announcements, calendars and files, and submit assignments with explicit confirmation.
